Openness.Low: Pragmatic, conventional, and detail-oriented — prefers structured tasks, concrete facts, and proven methods over abstract theories.
Openness.Moderate: Balanced outlook — appreciates established practices while remaining open to innovative approaches when beneficial.
Openness.High: Shows strong intellectual curiosity and openness to new experiences — likely to explore unconventional or creative career paths.

Conscientiousness.Low: Flexible, spontaneous, and informal — prefers adaptable environments over strict schedules or rigid structures.
Conscientiousness.Moderate: Methodical yet flexible — sets realistic goals and manages responsibilities effectively while adapting to changes.
Conscientiousness.High: Highly organized, disciplined, and goal-oriented — excels at systematic planning, detail precision, and long-term execution.

Extraversion.Low: Introverted, independent, and reflective — prefers quiet environments and deep focus over social stimulation.
Extraversion.Moderate: Ambiverted — comfortably balances social engagement with personal downtime depending on context.
Extraversion.High: Energetic, enthusiastic, and socially outgoing — thrives in collaborative, fast-paced, and people-oriented roles.

Agreeableness.Low: Competitive, skeptical, and direct — prioritizes objective outcomes and critical evaluation over consensus or harmony.
Agreeableness.Moderate: Cooperative yet firm — balances empathy and kindness with personal boundaries and pragmatic decision-making.
Agreeableness.High: Empathetic, compassionate, and highly cooperative — excels in supportive, team-focused, and service-oriented environments.

Neuroticism.Low: Calm, emotionally stable, and resilient under stress — unlikely to experience intense anxiety or mood swings.
Neuroticism.Moderate: Balances emotional reactivity with composure — experiences normal stress under pressure but generally maintains stability.
Neuroticism.High: Highly sensitive to environmental stress and emotional triggers — may benefit from supportive environments and stress management techniques.
